title: Assistant agent endpoint with a confirm-before-write tool
scenario: Security review blocked Kestrel's assistant: the prototype agent runs every tool the model asks for, including start_return, without permission checks. An injected product review could start a real return, and any customer could read another's order. Make the agent loop and API safe for the beta.
task: Read tools run automatically; start_return only creates a pending action
Confirm endpoint: owner and conversation bound, single use, expiring
Customer-scoped tools that do not leak other customers' orders
Max turns, is_error tool results, unknown tools, output cap, audit log
acceptance: No return without an owner's confirm inside the TTL, exactly once
Injected instructions in tool output cannot start a return
Another customer's order looks exactly like a missing one
Loop limits and audit entries as specified
